text: Capacity source record 1 describes a routine configuration note. It records scheduling, maintenance, review, documentation and audit details. The note is synthetic and has no external provenance or personal data. Each statement is deliberately ordinary so the workload is reproducible. No answer or task label is attached to this capacity-only fixture. The record remains within one declared 128-token source chunk. Operators use the note only to exercise the source encoder and writer. The text contains no instruction to the model and no hidden answer. Retention is limited to the declared capacity experiment directory. The same structure is repeated for each short capacity record. The measurement records actual token counts
